title: Amazing Monserrat
text: We had a great tour guide Clara  she was patient courteous and knowledgeable,, we took a bus the a train, after explaining all about Monserrat and the Black Madonna, we visited the sanctuary, if you like views this site has amazing ones  then  we went to a vinyard for wine tasting
author: Carola_M

title: Views are the best part
text: Laia was an exceptional guide! Especially when we ran into some unexpected and unavoidable hiccups. Beautiful views, not the best lunch, but made up for with the views from Oller del Mas
author: zmegma

title: Excellent experience!!! Montserrat and Winery!!!
text: Vince the guide, very knowledgeable about everything and a tremendous experience he gave us. Highly recommended. Montserrat very impressive and the treatment at the winery was very good.
author: noelsopena

title: Excellent tour with a passionate tour guide
text: The tour is wonderful with perfect timing and well organized. Our guide Kira is very professional, knowledgeable and friendly. We learned a lot of history, culture and social activities of Barcelona from her. She gave us very high level of wine knowledge with the wine tasting. Best tour for our holidays this time.
author: Sidney_N

title: Good tour to Montserrat!
text: Guillum was a very knowledgeable, funny and patient guide! He took very good care of us, and my husband and I had a great time.

title: Unforgettable trip

title: Amazing Experience, Fantastic Wine
text: The tour of Montserrat and Oller del Mas was fantastic! I would recommend seeing the Black Madonna as well. It was very cool in person. Guillem was an amazing guide, and the whole day felt very planned out and efficient. I cannot recommend it highly enough!
